tool_validation.reason_for_relevant_repeat: Initial cmd UNC cwd warning fixed by local Push-Location; final Rust added known pre-spawn stop cancellation. All earlier tests/fixtures passed but are preliminary, not final-source evidence. Invalid PE case keeps stdin open to exercise CreateProcess failure rather than cancelling at EOF.

limits: Real host ran only explicit no-input check_host_worker example and owned invalid-PE fixture, never default capture worker with a valid configuration; no Hook/SendInput/driver/real user configuration.
Fixture epoch is synthetic; code0/actual process exit/resource report/NotFound do not prove CaptureSession progress or global key recovery.
Locator avoids PATH/shell and default sibling escapes but does not authenticate image, signatures, ACLs or resist trusted-path replacement; trusted deployment remains required.
resources_complete covers explicit returned pipe/config resource reports; native Job/process handle Drop is not a separate successful-close proof.

Input thread provides Enter/input/EOF stop; native console Ctrl+C handler, detailed diagnostics, hot config, GUI, trusted packaging and normal Windows11/hardware capture remain. Linux bootstrap/consumer readiness, D05, Rust driver and companion audit plus original scope continue.
Prior x86 process/MSVC-overlap anomalies remain unknown; new checks are not fix claims.

Known startup cancellation reports no created child, not an observed child exit; cancellation success requires explicit complete cleanup. Stop arriving after last pre-spawn check still uses cooperative stop, not an atomic no-create guarantee.
